title: Integration-normalized bundle orientation and geometric typing facts
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian, $d\in\mathbf N$, and $M$ a locally free $\mathcal O_S$-module of constant rank $d$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], with vector bundle $\pi:E\to S$ and zero section $z$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Let $N>0$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and assume $N$ is invertible on $S$. Use the fixed vector integration [def-amb-vector-integration], its actual ordinary-etale Brown adjunction [def-pur-vector-integration-adjunction-arrows], and the ordered coefficient $A_S(d)[2d]$ [def-amb-vector-integration-charts]. With $\mathrm{bundleRight}$, $\mathrm{bundleAdjoint}$ and $\mathrm{bundleSectionAdjoint}$ defined in [def-pur-finite-ring-section-data], define $\mathrm{bundleOrientation}:Lz^*(\pi^\times\mathbf1_S)\simeq A_S(d)[2d]$ as the inverse of the isomorphism associated to the specified zero-section integration adjunct. Its named typing fact states that both the bundle adjunct and its zero-section restriction are invertible; no arbitrary isomorphism is selected. The same interface records the geometric typing fact: for schemes $V,S$ with $S$ Noetherian, a separated quasi-compact compactifiable smooth morphism $g:V\to S$ of pure relative dimension $d$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-asd-compactifiable], and a closed section $s$ with $g\circ s=1_S$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], the proposition $\mathrm{Geometry}(d,g,s)$ of [def-pur-finite-ring-section-data] holds. Thus the actual Rees cone can be used without assuming independent geometry data. These are the existing orientation construction and its typing facts; no DNC comparison naturality or diagonal identification is asserted. The empty base and $d=0$ are included.

def bundleOrientation (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (M : S.Modules) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A (VectorBundleZeroSection.zero S d M)).obj
        ((bundleRight A S d M).obj (𝟙_ _)) ≅
      affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d
